Profile

A short introduction

I'm Limsathya San — 陕炎烽 in Chinese, សាន្ត លីមសត្យា in Khmer. I grew up in Siem Reap, and today I study medicine at Kunming Medical University.

Getting here wasn't a straight line. I began with business at Build Bright, moved abroad to Tongji in Shanghai for pre-medicine, and settled into medicine in Kunming. Alongside the coursework I build software, make photographs, and create content — and I'm endlessly curious about languages, Chinese most of all.
